title: The Hunger Games
blurb: Katniss Everdeen is pulled into a televised contest where survival becomes a public spectacle. Her instincts, alliances, and one impossible act of defiance begin to unsettle the rules of Panem.

title: Catching Fire
blurb: The Capitol wants a victory tour, but the districts are reading a different message in Katniss's survival. As pressure builds, old games return with sharper stakes and fewer safe choices.

title: Mockingjay
blurb: With Panem in open conflict, Katniss becomes a symbol whose image travels farther than she can. The final movement of the rebellion asks what freedom costs after the cameras turn away.

title: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
blurb: Decades before Katniss, a young Coriolanus Snow is assigned to mentor a tribute in a Games still finding its shape. Ambition, performance, and a dangerous bond reveal the roots of a future regime.

title: Sunrise on the Reaping
blurb: On the morning of a pivotal reaping, Haymitch Abernathy is drawn into a spectacle designed to make fear feel ordinary. The arena becomes a pressure chamber for loyalty, memory, and quiet resistance.
